notes.title: Version 1.5.0: Updates and New Features
notes.notes:
As we continue our work on version 2.0, we decided it would be great to release an update with a bunch of great new features!

[u][b]IMPORTANT NOTE:[/b][/u] If you already have a save file from the previous version, it will trigger an error message when opened. Just delete this file and start a new one. We promise the new experience is way better!

Catnip Fever Dreamland v1.5.0 Features:

[list]
[*] Enemies that guard the catnip
[*] Unlockable kick attacks
[*] Unlockable power-up ability that doubles damage to enemies
[*] Improved maps resulting in a smoother experience
[*] Ability to zoom out and see more of the map (using LT/L2)
[*] Optimized graphics and customizable scope for Multiplayer
[/list]

Thank you for your continued patience for v2.0! We look forward to finishing the implementation of boss battles and a leaderboard that offers occasional cash prizes. The technical and legal aspects of these last updates are holding us up, but it will be worth the wait once it's all figured out.

[u][b]Side Note:[/b][/u] Since one more build that affects Story mode is on the way, you may want to only play enough to unlock some Multiplayer features, and spend some time playing with friends instead. Save data might not be accessible after the release of v2.0.
